items.q: Which of the following best describes Press history?
o: the falling sales and advertising that have forced titles to close
a system that charges readers before allowing access to online articles
a body that hears complaints against newspapers and rules on them
the record of how newspapers grew, changed ownership and shaped public debate
items.s: Press history: the record of how newspapers grew, changed ownership and shaped public debate. The other options describe Press council, Paywall, Decline of print.
